transcript: Speaker A: भाई, इनको मार्क्स से कुछ मतलब नहीं है, बस इंग्लिश बोलनी आनी चाहिए। [Brother, they don't care about marks, you just need to know how to speak English.] Speaker B: Mam, there is lot of traffic ahead. Should I take another route? Speaker A: हाँ ठीक है भैया। लेकिन आप इतनी अच्छी इंग्लिश कैसे बोल लेते हो? [Yes, okay brother. But how do you speak such good English?] Speaker B: मैम ये देखिए, मैं PW Talk ऐप यूज़ करता हूँ। ऑटो चलाने के बीच-बीच में थोड़ा सा देख लेता हूँ, कुछ 10-15 मिनट दिन का इसमें। इसमें एक AI टीचर है Riva करके, उसके साथ बात करो तो बताती रहती है कि कैसे fluent इंग्लिश में बात करनी है। Self-paced exercise भी है जो मैं अपने हिसाब से करता रहता हूँ। आजकल इंग्लिश में ना बोल पाओ तो कोई इज्जत ही नहीं करता, तो सीखना भी पड़ता है। [Mam, look at this, I use the PW Talk app. I look at it in between driving the auto, some 10-15 minutes a day. There is an AI teacher in it called Riva, if you talk to her, she keeps telling you how to speak fluent English. There are also self-paced exercises which I keep doing at my own pace. Nowadays, if you can't speak in English, no one respects you, so you have to learn.]

Should I take another route? theek hai bhaiya, lekin aap itni acchi English kaise bol lete ho? mam ye dekhiye, main PW Talk app use karta hoon auto chalane ke beech beech mein thoda sa dekh leta hoon kuch 10-15 minute din ka ismein ismein ek AI teacher hai Riva karke uske saath baat karo toh batati rehti hai ki kaise fluent English mein baat karni hai self paced exercise bhi hai jo main apne hisaab se karta rehta hoon aaj kal English mein na bol pao toh koi izzat hi nahi karta toh seekhna bhi padta hai
summary: An auto-rickshaw driver surprises his passenger by speaking fluent English. He explains that he practices 10-15 minutes daily on the PW Talk app with its AI teacher, Riva, emphasizing how easy it is to learn on the go.
